# Indian Institute of Insolvency Professionals of ICAI (India) ![](https://img.youtube.com/vi/Nf6cdsx5g6s/hqdefault.jpg) 2 years ago (Jun 22, 2022) — 2:24:15 [https://youtube.com/watch?v=Nf6cdsx5g6s](https://youtube.com/watch?v=Nf6cdsx5g6s)

## Summary The International Webinar on Cross Border Insolvency and Global Lessons for India, organized by the Indian Institute of Insolvency Professionals of ICAI India and the International Insolvency Institute USA, commenced with welcome addresses from JC Paul, Ravi Mital, Debasis Mitra, Evan J Zucker, and Ashok Haldia. The speakers discussed the need for a cross-border framework for resolution of insolvencies and bankruptcy in an effective, fair, and transparent manner. The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code 2016 in India provides a framework for cross-border insolvencies, but it has not been fully implemented. The webinar aimed to learn from the experience of the United States and other countries in developing a detailed framework for cross-border insolvency in India. The speakers included the Chairman of IBBI, the President of ICAI, the Chief General Manager of SBI, the Council of Black Rome LLP and Triple I Next Gen Chairperson USA, and the Chairman of Triple IPI. They discussed the benefits of adapting the Model Law, the challenges in implementing it in India, and the experiences of other countries in dealing with cross-border insolvency situations. The webinar also included a panel discussion and a special address by JC Paul, Chief General Manager, Sector Stressed Assets Resolution Group, State Bank of India.
